title: Books beyond the market
lines: Some subjects need a whole book but attract only a small audience.
That can make them uneconomic for a human author.
AI gives us a chance to fill that gap.
A book gives complex ideas room to develop and connect.
Readers can follow an argument instead of rebuilding it through scattered answers.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Readers can follow an argument instead of rebuilding it through scattered answers.

metaphor: The library is a collection of distinct volumes; its name labels the collection, not a book.

title: Human direction, shared work
lines: Experts supply the questions, structure, and corrections.
Our AI systems use that guidance to develop books and new editions.
Readers contribute by challenging claims and adding missing perspectives.
Each edition can build on what readers and experts have learned.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Each edition can build on what readers and experts have learned.

metaphor: Expert notes inform AI-assisted editions; readers contribute to subsequent revisions.

title: Reuse the thinking
lines: When you open a book, you reuse the thinking that shaped it.
A good niche book gathers questions you might not know to ask.
For depth, that can serve you better than starting another agent conversation.
Instead of repeating the exploration, readers share one developed account.
That can reduce repeated AI computation, its energy use, and its cost.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: That can reduce repeated AI computation, its energy use, and its cost.

metaphor: One developed book supports multiple readers, illustrating reuse rather than measured savings.

title: Room for different voices
lines: This applies to fiction as well as technical subjects.
Science fiction can explore possibilities that mainstream markets leave aside.
Other literary forms can also matter deeply to small audiences.
A library can preserve that cultural diversity without requiring mass appeal.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: A library can preserve that cultural diversity without requiring mass appeal.

metaphor: Different volumes represent different literary forms and small audiences.

title: Ask your librarian
lines: Ask the AI Librarian about the subject you want to explore.
Describe your question, your interests, or the kind of fiction you enjoy.
The librarian recommends books from this collection.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: The librarian recommends books from this collection.

metaphor: A natural-language request produces catalogue recommendations through Ask AI Librarian.

title: Choose your depth
lines: Open a book to see what it covers.
Choose the ten-minute edition for a first look.
Switch to the complete book when you want the detail.
Some books also have an animated introduction.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Some books also have an animated introduction.

metaphor: Short and complete reading editions belong to a book.

title: Read your way
lines: Choose your reading language on the book page.
Available editions open directly.
If a translation is missing, you can request it.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: If a translation is missing, you can request it.

metaphor: Language choices distinguish available editions from translation requests.

title: Help shape the library
lines: Use Suggest an Edit to challenge a passage or add expert guidance.
Use Create to propose a missing book or contribute a document.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Use Create to propose a missing book or contribute a document.

metaphor: Two contribution actions offer editing guidance or a proposed book, without naming a temporary delivery channel.

title: Find your next book
lines: Start with a question that deserves more than a quick answer.
Ask the librarian, find a book, and take the time to explore.

emotionalPlan.arc: An overlooked need, collective possibility, shared value, cultural breadth and an invitation to read.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Ask the librarian, find a book, and take the time to explore.

metaphor: The shared librarian returns the visitor to the collection.
